steps.name: Swordsman's Test (1)
steps.objective: After talking with [Jin] at the "Luman Union Headquarters", defeat [Landain] at the "Superhuman Memorial" and obtain the <Magic Stone of Disillusionment>. Then go to [Pulse] in the “Underground City of Tartarus”.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Thank you for coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What did you have to say to me that you called me?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Your expression is full of worry. As promised, I didn't tell anyone that you met Vice.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: However, the Sword God seemed to know.  Seeing as you said to yourself that you have already obtained traces of the three... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The superhumans must have felt something. Shinik from Tartarus and Medea from Kali both said things that seemed like they knew in advance... .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I don't know much about that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When can I meet Jiscard? I think I need to get a trace of power... .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: He'll probably call you soon. Please wait a moment. Now, Geomshin left the room for a moment to find out more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't help it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now that I think about it, I can’t see Iris. I told you not to visit Luman often, but….)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Iris is not here right now. They say he's been going into the Poison Fog Swamp of Illusion and not coming out often these days.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like my thoughts were read.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Now let's stop talking about other things and get to the point.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please speak.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Geomshin says he needs something before meeting you. Get me some stuff.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe you're testing me?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I guess so. When the Geomshin creates a person, he looks at the person’s vessel. My students and I also went through that process.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I bring?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: He asked me to leave it to the wizard there as soon as I find the magic stone at the Superhuman Memorial in Tartarus. You need two.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Come to think of it, you defeated the man named Landain who controlled the Superhuman Memorial Hall, right?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I don't think you can't find him just because you knocked him out. Geomsin said that you can see places that cannot be seen... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, I'm not sure, but I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Everyone knows about me even if I don’t keep it a secret….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What else is there after leaving the items?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: That's what the wizard will say. That much I know... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Let’s go.

steps.name: Swordsman's Test (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Enemy Tractus] at “God’s Tree, Lapier” and obtain <Illusion Tree Seed>. Then go to [Tiya] in the “Amalun Desert”.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They don't know that someone else has come. This hasn't happened once or twice... .

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Oh, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I got the item. Now, here… .

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: This is the magic stone that brainwashed a man named Landain. It may have already taken effect, but... .

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: In any case, we plan to analyze it as requested by the Union.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have something to ask. What information can be obtained by analyzing this magic stone?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: We don't know that yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know that there are many people who analyze the magic stones created by the Deimos Church. However, I don't think I have been able to come up with a proper answer so far.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: We will analyze it our way, and they will analyze it their way and utilize it in their own way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: The reason there is no proper answer is... . This is because the magic stones made by the Deimos Church gradually evolved into different forms.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: If it was a pattern of extracting the power of life, creating it, and brainwashing other life forms, recently some unbelievable things have been discovered.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Please understand that I cannot tell you clearly because I am not sure yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I got it.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I know that Adventurer’s work is very hard, but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just… ?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I hope you don't lose yourself. Although this is said by a wizard who lacks skills in dealing with people, I don't think it is wrong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Pulse. So what should we do now?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I don't know where you can get it, but you can get the Seeds of the Illusion Tree and give them to Tiyaran in the Amalun Desert. About 50?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you going to plant it in the desert? ?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I don't know about that either... . Only he knows that. Well then, that’s enough for my research… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . If it's the seed of the Welcome Tree, then I guess I'll have to go to Lapier.

steps.name: Swordsman's Test (3)
steps.objective: Go to [Yuran] at the “Luman Coalition Headquarters”.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer. nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here's what you asked for... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I was waiting for something from Luman Yuran to send, and it was this.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Luman and the nearby Kingdom of Judd said I could stay here, so I tried to do a little work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Adventurer, what is the name of this seed?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is said to be the seed of the welcome tree. It comes from a tree that only grows on sacred ground.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: These seeds are carried and sown by Hwansoo, who are particularly sacred animals.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: It's fascinating. Now that I think about it, they are similar to our kids... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. Maybe that's why they all hate me and ask me questions often.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: That is proof that you are loved. From this seed... . I feel like a special person. Have you met a new god?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain to Tiya what has happened.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The God who created the earth... . He too has been through a lot. Same goes for Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: And their greed for power ended up similar to my brother's... . In a way, this is a natural result... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything else you would like to ask? What items should I get and where should I go... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: No. I don't have anything like that. I think I just need to go back to Luman and listen to Yuran’s story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then what is Yuran talking about?...)

steps.name: Swordsman's Test (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Jin] at the “Luman Coalition Headquarters” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You're busy. It seems like it's been a while since I last saw you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot has happened in the meantime.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I know that in addition to experiencing several strange phenomena, you also encountered Vice. Also, thank you for helping us with the work in the Amalun Desert.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I received a lot of help every time. Once again, I would like to thank you as a member of the coalition.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems like their attitude towards me has changed...)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You don't have to doubt it. I am speaking as a member of the union and as a disciple of Master... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: And I am always grateful for wool.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since I can't see Wool, it looks like he's gone training again.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes, he is... . Let's say hello at this point, and Master has something to say.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He asked me to wait because he would tell me about a certain relic soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's a relic... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm not sure what that artifact is, but it looks like it will soon be used for something important to our union.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Oh, but there are a lot of people. What's going on?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: This time, while subduing the Kingdom of Moss, we decided to expand exchanges with the Sylvaria Empire on the Continent of Freios.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: So, some members of the Sylvaria Empire still remain to work. Although Phobos is reluctant to do so.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phobos? Where is it?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It is a small city in the northwest of Eastland. Because it is a remote place, there is little interaction, but the influence of the Deimos Church is less.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You might go when the time comes. There is also a story that an evil king is staying nearby.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phobos... .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Hey, Yuran. Is the story over?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: %s, come towards me. Because I have something left to say.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Adventurer. I have some work to do, so I'm leaving. Let’s talk to Jin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Yuran. Well then, good luck.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: You did a good job with what the swordsman asked you to do. thanks.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What… . Then please say what you wanted to say.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: It seems that the Sylvaria Empire conducted some investigation based on Mara's remarks.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: This story came up while interrogating Mara. Mara admitted that she was a fake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fake Agashura... . It was definitely strange. In order to create Agashuraman's kingdom, he joins hands with the Kingdom of Moss and messes up many places... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At least the Agashura I know doesn't move like that.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Yeah. Because a typical Agashura does not carry a magic stone and install it. Then let me continue.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Ban and Mara received the power to create magic stones from Weiss, and with that they recognized themselves as Agashura.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vice… .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: This is a fact that Mara directly told the Sylvaria Empire. Some of the content was shared with us.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Mara said that Ban was killed by Vice. However, he seemed to have forgotten about you who were there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did Vice have a hand in it? .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: That may be so. Perhaps Agashura's contract... would.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You knew it. They're fake... .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Mara told the whole story. Weiss could have manipulated her memories so that she wouldn't even say that, but she didn't.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: He must be up to something.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Anyway, what Ban and Mara were doing was no different from what Vice and the Deimos Church were doing. You probably know this too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: So far, suspicious parts have been cleared up based on a lot of evidence. The power of the magic stone, to be exact, the power that Weiss has gathered... .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: We are heading towards Avalon now. To the place that everyone in Eastland curses... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Avalon was said to be the place where Demigod Frozen went... Deimos, the capital of the dark kingdom...)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: It's a place you and all of us may have to go someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which side is it on?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: It's a little further north than Lumen. Thanks to you, a big burden has been relieved. Now all that's left are them and the demons of the demon world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are too many things fake people have done in this land.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: It's not over yet. I'll try harder until then, so please take care of me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please take care of me too. Now I'm going to go organize the remaining matters.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I wish you luck. %s… .
